should_trigger.prompt: write a SECURITY.md for this repo
define our security policy and what's in scope for reports
set up a vulnerability disclosure policy for the project
document which parts of the system are in bounds for security researchers
we need a SECURITY.md before launch — scope it to the API only, marketing site excluded
what should our vulnerability disclosure policy promise reporters?
a researcher emailed us about a bug last night and we had nothing to tell them about what's in scope or how we'd respond
should_trigger.note: situation phrasing: describes the circumstance without reusing the description's routing vocabulary — tests under-triggering, the axis lexical overlap hides
